**On lap 38 Hamilton was P3 on Softs and 2.179 s quicker than Russell, who was P7 on Mediums.**

| | Hamilton | Russell |
|---|---|---|
| Position | P3 | P7 |
| Tyre | Soft, 23 laps old | Medium, 38 laps old |

On race time, Russell was 39.8 s behind Hamilton after lap 38.

The tyre ages are the obvious suspect for the pace gap: Russell's Mediums were 38 laps old against 23 for Hamilton's Softs. One lap cannot separate that from traffic, so treat it as a likely cause rather than a measured one.
